documents.title: Build Contract
documents.content:
# Build Contract: Invoice helper

## Objective

Let a freelancer send and track an invoice reminder.

## Source

- Problem Case version: 2
- Delivery targets: web

## Constraints

- Ship within 72 hours

## Non-goals

- Payment processing
- Market-fit scoring

## Primary workflow

- Actor: Freelancer
- Trigger: An invoice becomes overdue

1. Open invoice
2. Send reminder
3. See reminder status

Success: The reminder is recorded and delivered.

## Build shape

- Stack: Next.js, FastAPI, PostgreSQL
- Components: Reminder API
- Integrations: Email provider

## Completion boundary

The build is complete only when every required feature meets its acceptance criteria and the relevant checks in `TEST_PLAN.md` have been run and recorded. Anything outside this contract requires an explicit decision before implementation.
